title: Subscribe and save for consumables
problemStatement: Consumable reorders are manual, so repeat purchase depends on the customer remembering. A subscription option was broken out with the tech lead into 30 discrete items across catalogue, checkout, billing and account management.
successMeasure: 15% of consumable revenue on subscription within two quarters of launch.

sizing.basis: Broken out into exactly 30 items during refinement. Stated as a fixed count so that every day of the resulting range is delivery variability rather than sizing doubt — which is the point this ask is used to demonstrate.

valueEstimate.basis: Consumables are 22% of monthly revenue; 15% of that on subscription at a 9pp higher retention rate, annualised

assumptions: Existing billing provider supports recurring charges without new PCI scope
